rule: Every quality completion receipt must be exportable as a backend-ready audit record before production learning storage or shared confidence updates are allowed.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or unexported receipt can reach recommendation weights in phase one.
export_principles: Package completion receipts into backend-ready audit records.
Keep receipt id, source action, proof delta, confidence decision, rollback state, and blocked route together.
Separate private organization memory from exportable aggregate audit metadata.
Require export readiness before production storage or cross-organization learning uses a receipt.
Preserve blocked payment-custody routes as audit guardrails.
Make retry, hold, and rollback states visible before an export is marked ready.
Keep the export copy-ready until a real backend endpoint exists.

role_exports.rollback_state: restore prior rank if proof is disputed
restore prior visibility if proof expires
restore prior market queue if response drops

acceptance: Marketplace shows Receipt Audit Export after Quality Completion Receipts.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show record id, receipt event, source action, export scope, privacy boundary, storage route, export state, rollback state, and blocked route.
Copy output explains export event, receipt event, record id, privacy boundary, storage route, rollback, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v176 Receipt Audit Export contract after the Quality Completion Receipts contract.
Docs include export states, export routes, blocked payment routes, and required export fields.
Static check fails if the export UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No production learning storage can use a receipt unless its audit export is ready or explicitly held.
